Maya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: the outage. RCA link: https://redwood.company/rca/INC-2026-042. Using this thread to capture owners for the action items and short ETAs. Keep replies brief. :memo:

Ken: I'll own the rollback playbook and smoke tests. ETA: 2026-03-28 10:00 UTC. I'll add steps to `playbooks/kv-rollback.md` and include verification commands.

Lina: I'll update the oncall runbook and add the new alert thresholds (stall_rate > 1.5% for 3m). ETA: 2026-03-28 14:00 UTC.

Vik: I can draft the customer note for Hosted + Dedicated and coordinate Legal/PR signoff. Draft 1 by 2026-03-28 16:00 UTC.

OpsBot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2026-042-ALLHANDS and assigned Ken/Lina/Vik. Link: https://redwood.company/tasks/INC-2026-042-ALLHANDS.

Maya: Leadership Qs to capture: 1) Any SLO changes? 2) Dedicated customers - proactive outreach? 3) Who is on regression watch for 7 days?

Ken: No SLO changes today.

Vik: We will offer temporary Dedicated buffers to top-tier customers; Ops to confirm list. I'll prepare outreach template.

Lina: Platform Reliability will run the 7-day elevated watch. I'll post a morning dashboard snapshot here each day.

Maya: Please post final doc links here when done. I'll compile the action tracker and schedule a 48h sync. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
